data.exact_reserve_text: There were deteriorations on our closed years (2009-2018) primarily on the Healthcare class ($4.7m) contributing to an overall deterioration on closed years of $2.6m. The result on the closed years for financial year 2021 was a loss of $2.6m. In the financial year there was prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $5.3 million (2020: $1.1 million adverse).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Deteriorations primarily on the Healthcare class contributing to an overall deterioration on closed years.
Prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred reported for the financial year.

data.standardized_narrative: During the 2021 financial year the Syndicate recorded adverse prior-year reserve movements, driven primarily by deterioration on closed years (2009-2018) and specific adverse development in prior accident years. The Managing Agent reports closed-years deterioration concentrated in the Healthcare class, with an overall closed-years adverse impact reported at $2.6m, and a prior-accident-year adverse development of $5.3m. On aggregate, analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year gross strengthening (adverse re-estimate) of approximately $16.8m (3.09% of opening gross claims outstanding). COVID-19 related items (including unexpired risk reserve and the group's LPT arrangements) are referenced as drivers of reserve and premium movements.
raw_causal_phrases: There were deteriorations on our closed years (2009-2018) primarily on the Healthcare class ($4.7m) contributing to an overall deterioration on closed years of $2.6m.
The result on the closed years for financial year 2021 was a loss of $2.6m.
In the financial year there was prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $5.3 million (2020: $1.1 million adverse).
The unexpired risk reserve has arisen due to unexpired claims and unearned reinsurance premiums related to COVID-19 losses being in excess of gross unearned premium.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year reserve movement (PYD) is not provided as a single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure in the disclosures. Narrative quotes a closed-years deterioration of $2.6m and a prior-accident-year adverse development of $5.3m; however, these items' scopes (gross vs net) are not unambiguously labelled. A gross PYD was computed from the gross claims development triangle (page 32) as a fallback, producing +$16.809m (strengthening). The triangle extraction required reconciling some OCR/text transcription irregularities (e.g. '108,23'  108,231 and '07,202'  107,202). Amounts throughout are reported in the native currency of the financial statements (USD). Where the report explicitly states figures, those have higher confidence; the triangle-derived total is assigned a calculated confidence of 0.8.
